lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible vertical columns of high-luminance, vertically-oriented pixel clusters along the mid-to-upper flank; specific 2D coordinates are imprecise due to chromatic aberration and motion blur.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Grid-like arrangement where vertical columns of light-intensity pixel clusters align; distinct vertical stripes are not continuous lines but are formed by the vertical stacks of these clusters.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two to three horizontal lines of elevated luminance with adjacent shadow pixels, running parallel to the long axis of the body on the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately six distinct high-luminance pixel clusters distributed in two vertical rows within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.
